name: Dev Server
author: ClipBridge
summary: Open a terminal and run npm in your projects: install, start, build, stop.
description: Save the folders of your projects once, then start the dev server, install packages, build or run any npm script with one tap. It types the commands into the terminal on your computer, so put the terminal in front first, or tap Terminal. Your project list stays on this phone.

changelog.notes: First release, and the first extension with a script.

widgets.name: Server
widgets.description: Start and stop the dev server.
